summary: 39-year-old Matthew Pratt of Ridgway lost control of his Mazda RX7 on Red Mountain Pass (U.S. 550); the car tumbled ~370 ft down the embankment, likely airborne before striking rocks. Pratt extracted himself from the wreck and was airlifted from the crash site to St. Mary's Hospital in stable condition; cause under investigation by the Colorado State Patrol.
